title: Clone Interface
concept: The Clone interface provides an explicit deep copy operation — `.clone()` creates a new, independent value from an existing one.
why: In XIOM, moves are the default. Clone gives you an explicit way to opt into expensive copies when you truly need independent ownership of data.
tips: Clone is explicit — you opt in to copying, unlike implicit copy in other languages
Only implement Clone when copying is the right semantic — use references for sharing
Derive Clone when all fields are Clone — saves boilerplate
Clone is O(n) for collections — be mindful of performance
common_mistakes: Confusing Clone with Copy — Copy is implicit and cheap, Clone is explicit and may be expensive
Cloning when a reference would suffice — unnecessary allocations
Forgetting to clone nested fields — results in shared references instead of deep copies
